dictionary.title: People and Presence
dictionary.description: Who belongs to the home and the business: full profile, permissions, face, voice, habits, memories and moods.
dictionary.empty: Add a person or let {assistant} scan faces.
dictionary.presence_off: Presence recognition is not active right now.
dictionary.delete_body: Profile, photos, voiceprint and private data are erased. This cannot be undone.
dictionary.scanned_hint: {assistant} saw this face but doesn't know who it is: give it a name or link it to an existing person.
dictionary.scan_hint: The person stands in front of the server camera: press a view to capture it. More different views = more reliable recognition.
dictionary.training_hint: Training appears on the home screen: the person reads a few sentences aloud.
dictionary.memories_hint: Everything {assistant} learned about this person by talking with them. You can add or remove memories.
dictionary.mood_hint: Mood journal: filled in by you or by {assistant} when the person tells her. It stays encrypted.
dictionary.learned_hint: When the person speaks, the assistant adds what emerges (tastes, times, nickname) and logs the mood. Confirm or undo: mistakes are not repeated.
dictionary.learned_off: Automatic learning is turned off in the People settings.
dictionary.connectors_hint: Link personal accounts: Nuxiva uses them only for this person and only within the permissions of their role.
dictionary.tg_not_configured: The Telegram bot token is missing: set it once for the whole home in the Control Panel.
dictionary.tg_code_hint: Open Telegram and send the code {code} to {bot}. It expires in {seconds} seconds.
dictionary.gg_not_configured: The Google client ID and secret are missing: set them once for the whole home in the Control Panel.
dictionary.gg_paste_hint: After signing in with Google, copy the full address of the final page and paste it here.
dictionary.field_ui_language: Screen language in front of the display
dictionary.field_voice_language: Language the assistant speaks to them
dictionary.field_consent: Use this profile to personalise answers
dictionary.field_share_health: The assistant may use health data (e.g. medication reminders)
dictionary.house_description: Chronological log and predictive habit foresight
dictionary.house_proposals_empty: No proposals: Nuxiva makes one when it spots a habit.
dictionary.observed_hint: What they usually do at home, observed over the last {days} days when they were the only person present.
dictionary.reminders_hint: Birthdays, name days and important dates of the people in the registry.
dictionary.vitals_hint: Link a band, a watch or a phone: when it recognises you, Nuxiva reads heart rate, oxygen and temperature live and shows them on the display.
dictionary.vitals_lease: The device is read by node: {{node}}
dictionary.vitals_cloud_on: Google Health linked: data also arrives from the cloud.
dictionary.vitals_cloud_off: Google Health not linked: add the Google Health service from the Google card to receive cloud data.
dictionary.vitals_secret_phone: Open this link on the phone with the Nuxiva app to link «{{name}}». It is shown only once.
dictionary.vitals_secret_push: Key for «{{name}}», to use as Bearer on /api/vitals/push. It is shown only once.
dictionary.training_stale: Training was done when the assistant was called «{name}»: run it again to teach the current name.
dictionary.training_tip_far_weak: From a distance I hear you poorly: move the microphone closer or repeat the training nearer.
dictionary.training_tip_soft_weak: Whispers are hard for me: speak a bit louder or come closer.
dictionary.training_tip_mic_low: The microphone level is low: raise the microphone gain.
dictionary.training_tip_clipping: The microphone clips when you speak loudly: lower the gain.
dictionary.vitals_no_nodes: No Bluetooth available: the server has no Bluetooth adapter and no Bluetooth satellite is online.
dictionary.vitals_search_hint: For Fitbit and similar: open «Share heart rate» in the app and keep the screen on, then bring the device close to the server or a satellite: it shows up here within seconds.
dictionary.vitals_none_found: No device found: turn it on, bring it closer and retry.
dictionary.vitals_code_intro: On the phone open the Nuxiva app, choose «Connect vitals» and enter this code (valid {{minutes}} minutes):
dictionary.vitals_empty: No device connected. Search for a nearby device or connect your phone.
dictionary.vitals_state_hint_off: The device is disconnected: it will not be read until you reconnect it.
dictionary.vitals_state_hint_waiting: The device has not been seen yet: turn it on and bring it near a satellite.
dictionary.vitals_state_hint_seen: The device was seen nearby: connecting shortly.
dictionary.vitals_state_hint_connected: Connected: waiting for the first values.
dictionary.vitals_state_hint_unsupported: This device does not broadcast data in a standard way: use the phone app or the Google Health service.
dictionary.vitals_log_search_no_nodes: Search impossible: no Bluetooth satellite online
dictionary.vitals_log_lease_lost: The device is no longer reachable from {{node}}
dictionary.vitals_hint_no_profiles: Many watches and bands (Fitbit included) do not broadcast in a standard way: use the phone app (Health Connect) or connect Google Health from the Google card.
dictionary.vitals_hint_connect_failed: Bring the device closer, make sure it is not already connected to the phone and retry.
dictionary.vitals_hint_scan_failed: Check that the satellite's Bluetooth is on and the bluetooth service is running.
dictionary.vitals_hint_cloud_error: Check that you enabled the Google Health service in the Google card.
dictionary.vitals_hint_search_no_nodes: Start a satellite with Bluetooth and connect it to Nuxiva.
dictionary.vitals_hint_rejected_values: The device sends impossible values: check that it is worn properly.
dictionary.fp_hint: Fingerprint recognition. Readers on the server, nodes and satellites (USB, Bluetooth or Wi-Fi) are detected automatically and tied to their room. Fingerprints stay encrypted on the server.
dictionary.fp_no_readers: No reader detected: connect a reader to a node or satellite.
dictionary.fp_waiting: Place your finger ({{finger}}) on the reader and follow its prompts.
dictionary.wb_title: Real-time emotional insight and wellbeing path
dictionary.wb_hint: A support tool, not therapy and not a replacement for a professional: it gathers what emerges in full detail so you can compare it with a psychologist, psychiatrist or neurologist.
dictionary.wb_privacy: Video is analysed instantly and never stored: we keep only numeric values and session text, in a local SQLite database with encrypted fields, visible only after personal sign-in. You can export or delete everything at any time.
dictionary.wb_live_none: No recognised face in front of the camera right now.
dictionary.wb_estimate: Automatic non-clinical estimate, computed against your usual face.
dictionary.wb_due: It is time for the next session (planned {{date}})
dictionary.wb_mood_before: How do you feel right now? (0-10)
dictionary.wb_nearing: We are nearing the end: let's slow down and recap the session.
dictionary.wb_crisis: If you are in danger or thinking of hurting yourself, call emergency services or someone you trust now: the numbers are in the reply below.
dictionary.wb_report: Download the report for the professional
dictionary.wb_erase_confirm: Permanently delete this person's sessions, reports and measurements?
dictionary.wb_disclaimer: This is not a diagnosis or a treatment. If distress persists see a professional; in an emergency call 112 (EU), 911 (US) or your local number.
dictionary.tg_step_1: Open BotFather on Telegram and send /newbot (or use a bot you already have).
dictionary.tg_step_2: Copy the token BotFather sends you.
dictionary.tg_step_3: Open the control panel, paste the token in the “Telegram bot token” field and save.
dictionary.tg_step_4: Open the new bot in Telegram, press Start and then generate a new pairing code here.
dictionary.tg_change_hint: The bot token is changed from Telegram's control panel, which also has the full guide.
dictionary.vh_checklist: Checklist for Fitbit and similar devices:
dictionary.vh_reason_server_local_disabled: The server's Bluetooth is turned off (NUXIVA_VITALS_LOCAL_BLE=0).
dictionary.vh_reason_server_bleak_missing: The server is missing its Bluetooth component (bleak): update Nuxiva from the Update Center or install it with pip install bleak.
dictionary.vh_reason_server_no_adapter: The server has no Bluetooth adapter: plug in a USB one or use a node or satellite with Bluetooth.
dictionary.vh_reason_no_nodes: No Bluetooth node or satellite is online: without them and without server Bluetooth nobody can read the device.
dictionary.vh_step_1: In the Fitbit app open the device and turn on “Share heart rate” (or heart-rate broadcast): the device must stay in this mode.
dictionary.vh_step_2: Keep the device screen on and within 5 metres of the server, node or satellite.
dictionary.vh_step_3: If the device is already connected to a phone, close the Fitbit app or turn off the phone's Bluetooth: many devices accept only one connection at a time.
dictionary.vh_step_4: Press “Search nearby devices”, pick the device from the list and associate it with this person instead of typing the address by hand.
dictionary.vh_step_5: If it still does not appear, turn the device's Bluetooth off and on and retry: the list refreshes every few seconds.
dictionary.gg_remind_hint: For this person only. 0 = no reminder. Maximum 240.
